name: The Mock Turtle

revision.note: Rewritten from the human-in-partial-costume reading to a photoreal CGI fantastical creature.

rendering.rule: bible/cultivation.json SUP-010 (amended BIB-0027); anatomy detail owned by 04-creatures/creature
rendering.species: turtle-bodied creature (green-sea-turtle shell and front flippers) with a calf's head, calf hind legs ending in cloven hooves, and a calf's tail: the parts of 'mock turtle soup'
rendering.limits: Built as if a real animal: real shell, turtle skin, calf hide and hair, weight and wet light; the neck blends from turtle skin into calf hide. Speech by the calf's muzzle and lips. No clothing, no cartoon face, no human in costume.

gender_note.quote: Alice could hear him sighing as if his heart would break

base_age_note.reason: Persona age ('When we were little', ch009-p55; 'Once I was a real Turtle', ch009-p53), kept for voice casting. As a creature: an old turtle with a worn, barnacle-spotted shell and a calf's face that looks faded and tired.

hair.coat: shell and turtle skin (body); short calf hair (head, hind legs, tail)
hair.color: carapace olive-brown with faded amber-and-dark hexagonal scutes; grey-olive scaled turtle skin on flippers and neck; brown-and-white patched calf head with a white blaze
hair.style: calf hair damp and flattened; shell scuffed with a few barnacles
hair.reason: Turtle and calf cues per SUP-010.

eyes.expression: brimming with tears, lids reddened; shuts them when he yawns
eyes.quote: looked at them with large eyes full of tears
eyes.reason: Size and tears sourced; colour follows the calf head.

skin.tone: pink-grey wet calf nose; tear-wet matted hair on the cheeks
skin.quote: with tears running down his cheeks

face.shape: long, mournful calf's head with soft floppy ears
face.expressiveness: ear droop, eye tears, muzzle quiver and heaving shell; no human expressions

build.height_note: Head height when sitting upright on his calf hind legs against a rock; carapace length about 110-120 cm.
build.posture: sits slumped and upright on a rock ledge, leaning back on the shell, front flippers used as hands; heavy and slow except when he suddenly 'jumps about like mad' in the Quadrille, flippers flapping
build.quote: the two creatures, who had been jumping about like mad things all this time, sat down again very sadly and quietly
build.reason: Upright sitting is a dream licence so he can talk face to face; size designed smaller than the Gryphon.

scale_reference.in_scene: Seated on a low rock ledge, his eye line roughly level with Alice standing (about 135 cm); smaller and softer than the Gryphon beside him.

marks.description: front flippers ('flappers') used as hands: counting subjects, wiping his eyes
marks.quote: drew the back of one flapper across his eyes

also.quote: counting off the subjects on his flappers

marks.description: calf hind legs with small black cloven hooves, and a tufted calf tail at the back of the shell
permanent tear tracks and reddened eyelids

default_outfit_tone.summary: none: he wears nothing; his look is the shell, flippers and calf parts
default_outfit_tone.reason: The text gives him no clothing; per SUP-010 (BIB-0027) the old frock coat, shell cape and calf-hide waistcoat are dropped. The old designed handkerchief prop is also dropped (not in the text).

prompt_base_en: photoreal mock turtle creature sitting slumped upright on a rock ledge by the sea, large olive-brown domed turtle shell with faded hexagonal scutes and a few barnacles, grey-olive scaled front flippers, a brown-and-white calf's head with a white blaze and floppy drooping ears, large dark brown eyes full of tears, tear-wet cheeks, calf hind legs with small black cloven hooves, tufted calf tail, naturalistic anatomy and wet light, live-action film plate
